universal_research_rules: Detect a change before searching for a stock.
Write the causal chain from external change to earnings and expectations.
Separate fact, interpretation, estimate, and unknown.
Classify demand quality; do not equate pipeline with contracted demand.
Model supply response and scarcity duration.
Establish what is priced in before declaring a thesis variant.
Use industry-specific valuation and accounting checks.

fields.economic_engine: Oilfield activity × service intensity × day/rental rates; economics hinge on upstream capex and equipment utilization.
fields.core_kpis: Rig count; frac spreads; utilization; day rates; backlog/book-to-bill; service pricing; offshore awards; FCF conversion.
fields.leading_indicators: E&P capex budgets; oil/gas strip; tender activity; rig reactivations; equipment lead times.
fields.typical_moats: Technical know-how, installed fleet, high-spec equipment scarcity, customer qualification, local service network.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Very cyclical. High returns trigger fleet/equipment additions; offshore/high-spec assets can have multi-year supply lags.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, EV/FCF, replacement value, mid-cycle earnings.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Capitalized equipment costs, maintenance vs growth capex, contract backlog quality, asset impairments.
fields.common_failure_modes: Overbuilding capacity, commodity collapse, customer concentration, technological substitution, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset-light service niches with recurring consumables/software, high switching costs, disciplined capital allocation.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Utilization crosses threshold → pricing rises → incremental margins surge; offshore tender cycle turns.
fields.highest_evi_question: What utilization level historically unlocks pricing? How fast can idle/competing capacity return?

fields.economic_engine: Commodity price × production/refining/storage volumes − lifting/feedstock/capex; midstream adds fee-based throughput.
fields.core_kpis: Production; realized prices; breakeven; decline rate; reserves; crack spreads; throughput; inventories; FCF/bbl; leverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Futures curves; inventories; OPEC/supply policy; rig activity; refinery outages; pipeline flows; LNG capacity.
fields.typical_moats: Low-cost resource, advantaged acreage, scale, integrated assets, pipeline rights-of-way, long-term contracts.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Upstream/mining highly cyclical; pipelines slower; refinery capacity additions take years but utilization can swing quickly.
fields.valuation_lenses: NAV, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, EV/boe/d, P/NAV; DCF for contracted midstream.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Reserve estimates, hedging, asset retirement obligations, maintenance capex, working-capital swings, MLP adjustments.
fields.common_failure_modes: Commodity mean reversion, depletion, political/regulatory risk, leverage, poor acquisitions, stranded assets.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Low-cost reserves or fee-based infrastructure with disciplined reinvestment and per-share capital returns.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Supply deficit, refinery bottleneck, gas/LNG basis change, capex discipline creates FCF step-up.
fields.highest_evi_question: What marginal supply sets price, and what capex is required to sustain—not grow—production?

fields.economic_engine: Price × volume − feedstock/energy; mix ranges from commodity plants to high-value formulations.
fields.core_kpis: Price/mix; volumes; utilization; feedstock spreads; inventories; EBITDA/ton; working capital; ROIC.
fields.leading_indicators: Distributor inventories; plant operating rates; ethane/naphtha spreads; customer production; capacity shutdowns.
fields.typical_moats: Process know-how, formulation IP, qualification, switching costs, scale, feedstock advantage.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Commodity chemicals respond via plant additions/closures; specialty capacity often less fungible and slower to qualify.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, normalized FCF, P/E, replacement cost; specialty names may warrant ROIC-based DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Inventory gains/losses, restructuring add-backs, environmental liabilities, pension costs, maintenance capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Capacity glut, feedstock disadvantage, customer destocking, China supply, environmental liabilities.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialty portfolio with specification lock-in, recurring formulations, pricing power and low capital intensity.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Destocking ends → utilization/pricing recover; feedstock spread widens; competitor capacity exits.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is the product truly differentiated or merely marketed as specialty?

fields.economic_engine: Local price × volume − quarry/cement/aggregate production and freight costs; geography matters enormously.
fields.core_kpis: Tons/shipments; price/ton; aggregates margins; cement utilization; backlog; public/private construction mix.
fields.leading_indicators: Infrastructure awards; housing starts; nonres construction; DOT budgets; cement imports; weather.
fields.typical_moats: Permits/reserves, local scarcity, transportation economics, route density, vertical integration.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: New quarries/cement plants face permitting and long lead times; local shortages can persist for years.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF, value per reserve ton, replacement value.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Depletion, reclamation liabilities, acquisition accounting, weather normalization, land values.
fields.common_failure_modes: Construction downturn, overpaying for reserves, energy inflation, permitting changes.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Local oligopoly with scarce permitted reserves and consistent price > cost inflation.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Volume trough + continued price increases; infrastructure spend hits constrained local supply.
fields.highest_evi_question: How many years of permitted reserves exist, and can competitors economically truck material into the market?

fields.economic_engine: Units × price/mix − resin/metal/fiber and conversion cost; demand tied to consumer/industrial volumes.
fields.core_kpis: Volumes; price-cost spread; resin/paper/aluminum inputs; utilization; contract resets; EBITDA/ton/unit.
fields.leading_indicators: Packaging volumes; retailer inventories; resin/pulp prices; capacity closures; customer contract renewals.
fields.typical_moats: Scale, customer integration, efficient plants, local freight advantage; usually modest differentiation.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Cyclical and prone to overcapacity; closures/consolidation can restore pricing.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, normalized margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Pass-through timing, restructuring charges, pension, lease obligations, maintenance capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Overcapacity, customer bargaining power, input spikes, secular packaging substitution.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche packaging with high switching costs, specialized formats, disciplined consolidation.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Capacity closures + demand stabilization → price-cost spread expansion.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are price increases contractual pass-throughs or genuine pricing power?

fields.economic_engine: Commodity price × volume − cash cost − sustaining/growth capex; ore grade and mine life dominate.
fields.core_kpis: Production; realized price; cash cost/AISC; grade; recovery; reserves; mine life; capex; jurisdiction exposure.
fields.leading_indicators: Spot/futures prices; inventories; Chinese demand; smelter treatment charges; mine disruptions; project approvals.
fields.typical_moats: Lowest-cost resource, reserve quality, scale infrastructure, scarce geology; little product differentiation.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Extremely cyclical; new mines can require 5–15 years, making supply lags long but eventual additions powerful.
fields.valuation_lenses: NAV, P/NAV, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, EV/reserve unit.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Reserve assumptions, stripping capitalization, impairment, reclamation, royalties, by-product credits.
fields.common_failure_modes: Commodity collapse, grade decline, political expropriation/tax, project overruns, bad M&A.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rare: royalty/streaming or exceptionally low-cost long-life assets with disciplined capital returns.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Supply disruption/deficit, inventory drawdown, capex drought, new mine ramp.
fields.highest_evi_question: Where is the marginal cost curve and what projects enter supply at today's incentive price?

fields.economic_engine: Pulp/lumber/paper price × volume − fiber/energy/freight; timber assets add biological growth and land optionality.
fields.core_kpis: Pulp/lumber prices; shipments; mill utilization; timber harvest; log costs; inventories; housing exposure.
fields.leading_indicators: Housing starts; pulp inventories; mill downtime; export demand; freight; capacity closures.
fields.typical_moats: Low-cost timberland/fiber basket, mill efficiency, local logistics; commodity moat otherwise limited.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Strong capital cycle; mill additions/closures drive multi-year pricing swings.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, timberland NAV, replacement value.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Biological asset accounting, depletion, maintenance capex, pension, restructuring.
fields.common_failure_modes: Overcapacity, housing recession, China demand weakness, wildfire, input inflation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Timberland with low-cost growth and disciplined harvest/land monetization.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Mill closures + demand rebound; lumber/pulp inventory cycle turns.
fields.highest_evi_question: What percentage of earnings is truly structural versus spot commodity pricing?

fields.economic_engine: Aircraft/defense installed base + production rates + aftermarket/service; defense adds funded backlog and program economics.
fields.core_kpis: Book-to-bill; backlog; aircraft deliveries; flight hours; aftermarket mix; program margin; cash conversion; defense awards.
fields.leading_indicators: OEM production schedules; airline traffic; defense budgets; supplier lead times; shop visits; engine cycles.
fields.typical_moats: Certification, IP, sole-source positions, installed base, long program lives, switching/requalification cost.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity/qualification can take years; aftermarket scarcity can persist; defense programs span decades.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF yield, sum-of-parts; aftermarket deserves higher multiple than OE.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Program accounting, customer advances, pension, warranty, development capitalization, one-time contract charges.
fields.common_failure_modes: Program delays, fixed-price overruns, supplier failure, leverage, aftermarket normalization.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Sole-source component/aftermarket supplier with growing installed base, high recurring content, disciplined M&A.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Production-rate recovery, aftermarket surge, defense award, supply bottleneck relief → margin step-up.
fields.highest_evi_question: What percentage of lifetime economics comes after the original equipment sale?

fields.economic_engine: Residential/nonres construction volume × product content × price − materials/labor; repair/remodel can stabilize.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; backlog; price/mix; housing starts; R&R mix; dealer inventory; gross margin; channel share.
fields.leading_indicators: Permits; housing starts; mortgage rates; builder orders; architectural billings; distributor inventories.
fields.typical_moats: Brand/specification, contractor preference, code approval, distribution, installed base, low product cost vs labor.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Plant capacity can often be added in 1–3 years; distribution/specification barriers may matter more than factories.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, through-cycle margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Channel inventory, rebates, acquisition intangibles, warranty reserves, housing-cycle normalization.
fields.common_failure_modes: Housing downturn, destocking, raw-material inflation, private-label competition.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Mission-critical low-ticket product with contractor pull-through, recurring replacement, high incremental ROIC.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Housing/order trough + destocking end; price-cost recovers; capacity absorption.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is the product selected by the contractor/specifier or commoditized by the distributor?

fields.economic_engine: Backlog conversion × project margin − labor/material overruns; cash flow depends on contract terms and working capital.
fields.core_kpis: Backlog/RPO; book-to-bill; gross margin; change orders; working capital; project mix; utilization.
fields.leading_indicators: Infrastructure awards; data-center/energy project FIDs; permitting; labor availability; customer financing.
fields.typical_moats: Engineering expertise, safety record, bonding capacity, customer relationships, specialized labor.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Labor and execution capacity are the bottleneck; competitors can scale but skilled teams take time.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF, backlog quality, P/E; avoid valuing pass-through revenue like value-add revenue.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Percentage-of-completion estimates, claims, change orders, retainage, customer advances, JV liabilities.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fixed-price overruns, project cancellations, labor inflation, customer insolvency.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialty contractor with repeat customers, low fixed capital and disciplined project selection.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Backlog surge + labor productivity + mix shift; margin normalization after troubled projects.
fields.highest_evi_question: How enforceable is backlog and who bears material/labor inflation?

fields.economic_engine: Units/capacity slots × price − copper/electrical components/labor; scarcity and qualification drive high incremental margins.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; backlog/RPO; book-to-bill; lead times; price/mix; plant utilization; data-center/grid exposure; margins.
fields.leading_indicators: Utility capex; transformer/switchgear lead times; data-center FIDs; grid interconnection; copper prices.
fields.typical_moats: Qualification, reliability, installed base, scarce factory slots, engineering integration, channel relationships.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: New transformer/switchgear capacity can take 2–5+ years including equipment/labor/qualification.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; backlog-adjusted earnings and normalized margin sensitivity.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Backlog definitions, advances, copper pass-through, project accounting, growth capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Ghost demand, capacity glut, hyperscaler bargaining, copper inflation, execution delays.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche electrical supplier with scarce capacity, high reliability and recurring service/retrofit demand.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Orders outrun revenue → backlog → utilization → margin; grid/data-center bottleneck migrates into equipment.
fields.highest_evi_question: Which orders are funded and binding, and when does new industry capacity arrive?

fields.economic_engine: Portfolio cash flows plus capital allocation; value depends on segment quality and management's reinvestment choices.
fields.core_kpis: Segment margins/ROIC; organic growth; FCF; acquisition multiples; portfolio mix; leverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Portfolio reviews; spin-offs; acquisitions; segment order trends; capital allocation changes.
fields.typical_moats: Capital allocation system, decentralized culture, shared distribution/technology; conglomerate discount may or may not be justified.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Depends on segments; acquisition capital cycle can become the key constraint.
fields.valuation_lenses: SOTP, FCF yield, EV/EBITDA, ROIC; compare implied segment multiples.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Corporate allocations, pension, intercompany items, acquisition adjustments, stranded costs.
fields.common_failure_modes: Empire building, opaque segments, leverage, bad M&A, conglomerate discount persistence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Decentralized operator with repeatable acquisition playbook and high incremental ROIC.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Spin/separation reveals higher-quality asset; margin reset; capital allocation regime changes.
fields.highest_evi_question: Does the corporate center create value beyond what independent segments could?

fields.economic_engine: Equipment units × price + aftermarket − manufacturing cost; highly sensitive to utilization and customer capex.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; book-to-bill; backlog; dealer inventories; utilization; price/cost; aftermarket mix; incremental margin.
fields.leading_indicators: PMI; construction/mining/ag equipment demand; dealer inventory; commodity farmer income; capex plans.
fields.typical_moats: Installed base, dealer network, application expertise, brand, parts/service ecosystem.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Factories respond in 1–3 years, but dealer/installed-base moats persist; end markets can be deeply cyclical.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF, normalized mid-cycle margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Dealer financing, inventory, warranty, pension, restructuring, acquisition intangibles.
fields.common_failure_modes: Dealer destocking, peak-cycle extrapolation, China competition, input inflation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche machinery with consumables/service, high aftermarket share, low customer failure tolerance.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Dealer inventory bottom, utilization rebound, price-cost turn, new product qualification.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much gross profit comes from aftermarket versus new machines?

fields.economic_engine: Volume × gross margin − logistics/SG&A; working-capital turns and local scale are central.
fields.core_kpis: Organic sales; gross margin; inventory turns; working capital; branch productivity; private-label mix; ROIC.
fields.leading_indicators: Industrial production; channel inventories; supplier lead times; customer order frequency; pricing.
fields.typical_moats: Distribution density, breadth, availability, procurement scale, embedded workflow, private label.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Physical capacity is easy; network density, data and relationships compound slowly.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC; working-capital-normalized FCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: LIFO/FIFO, inventory gains, supplier rebates, acquisition add-backs, receivables.
fields.common_failure_modes: Destocking, e-commerce disintermediation, inventory obsolescence, acquisition overpayment.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialty distributor with fragmented market, high service content, private label and bolt-on runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Destocking ends; gross margin recovers; working capital releases cash.
fields.highest_evi_question: What value does the distributor add that a manufacturer or online marketplace cannot replicate?

fields.economic_engine: Recurring service contracts × route/site density − labor/equipment; includes waste, facilities, security, office services.
fields.core_kpis: Organic price; retention; route density; labor utilization; recurring mix; acquisition multiples; FCF.
fields.leading_indicators: Contract renewals; wage inflation; disposal pricing; customer formation; regulation; acquisition pipeline.
fields.typical_moats: Route density, permits, local regulation, installed systems, switching friction, reputation.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Local networks take years to build; attractive returns invite bolt-on consolidation more than greenfield entry.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, ROIC; route businesses often deserve DCF on local density economics.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Acquisition adjustments, environmental reserves, landfill closure, lease classification, labor normalization.
fields.common_failure_modes: Labor inflation, contract repricing lag, poor M&A, environmental liabilities.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Waste/environmental/security niche with high retention, route density, pricing > inflation.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Price catches wages; route density improves; competitor exits; acquisition synergies.
fields.highest_evi_question: Can price rise annually without meaningful churn?

fields.economic_engine: Billable headcount/utilization × billing rate − compensation; data/process outsourcing adds recurring contracts.
fields.core_kpis: Utilization; bill rates; headcount; attrition; bookings; backlog; recurring mix; revenue per employee.
fields.leading_indicators: Hiring trends; wage inflation; client budgets; consulting demand; outsourcing awards; regulation.
fields.typical_moats: Reputation, specialized expertise, proprietary data, workflow integration, switching costs.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Human capital supply responds relatively quickly; proprietary data/workflow moats are more durable.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; revenue-per-employee and organic growth quality.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Capitalized software, stock comp, acquisition earnouts, billable vs non-billable headcount.
fields.common_failure_modes: Utilization collapse, wage pressure, automation/AI, client concentration.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Vertical data/analytics or outsourced mission-critical process with recurring contracts and high retention.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Hiring freeze ends, utilization rebounds, pricing outpaces wages, large outsourcing award.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is the moat people-based or embedded in proprietary data/workflows?

fields.economic_engine: Shipment volume × yield/spread − transport procurement/labor; asset-light brokers differ from asset-heavy integrators.
fields.core_kpis: Tonnage; yield; load factor; purchased transportation; spot vs contract rates; working capital.
fields.leading_indicators: Freight indices; e-commerce; air cargo rates; inventories; port volumes; fuel.
fields.typical_moats: Network density, customs capability, scale purchasing, customer integration, route network.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Broker capacity adjusts fast; integrated global networks are slow and capital intensive.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; mid-cycle margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Fuel surcharges, purchased transportation gross vs net reporting, leases, pension.
fields.common_failure_modes: Rate collapse, excess capacity, labor, fuel, customer concentration.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset-light logistics with sticky vertical specialization and technology-enabled network effects.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Freight recession ends → rates/volumes recover; purchased transport spread expands.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are profits driven by structural network advantage or temporary rate spreads?

fields.economic_engine: Passengers × fare/yield − fuel/labor/aircraft ownership; high fixed costs create extreme operating leverage.
fields.core_kpis: RASM/PRASM; CASM ex-fuel; load factor; capacity; bookings; fare; loyalty economics; net debt.
fields.leading_indicators: TSA/booking data; capacity schedules; jet fuel; competitor cuts; corporate travel.
fields.typical_moats: Slots, hubs, loyalty programs, scale; historically weak due to low switching cost and high fixed costs.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Aircraft/crew capacity adjusts slowly but bankruptcies/restructurings reset economics.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDAR, FCF, normalized EPS; value loyalty separately when material.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Aircraft leases, loyalty deferred revenue, pension, special items, maintenance timing.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fare wars, fuel spikes, labor contracts, leverage, recession, aircraft grounding.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rare; loyalty/network with disciplined capacity and strong balance sheet.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Capacity cuts + resilient demand → fare/yield inflection; fuel decline.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is capacity discipline industry-wide or temporary?

fields.economic_engine: Freight rate × vessel days − fuel/opex; ship supply orderbook and route demand drive economics.
fields.core_kpis: Spot/contract rates; utilization; fleet age; orderbook; scrapping; ton-miles; breakeven.
fields.leading_indicators: Orderbook deliveries; port congestion; trade flows; canal constraints; commodity demand.
fields.typical_moats: Low-cost fleet, niche routes/contracts; otherwise weak moat.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Very strong capital cycle: high rates trigger ship orders with 2–4 year delivery lag.
fields.valuation_lenses: NAV, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, fleet value.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Vessel values, depreciation, charter accounting, drydock capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fleet oversupply, rate collapse, leverage, geopolitics, environmental capex.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche contracted operator with scarce specialized vessels and disciplined fleet growth.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Orderbook tight + demand/ton-mile shock; congestion/geopolitical rerouting.
fields.highest_evi_question: What percentage of fleet capacity is already on order relative to demand growth?

fields.economic_engine: Rail/truck/bus volume × yield − labor/fuel/equipment; network density and capacity utilization determine margins.
fields.core_kpis: Carloads/loads; yield; OR; miles; driver/crew productivity; spot/contract rates; equipment utilization.
fields.leading_indicators: Freight indices; inventory cycle; industrial production; truck exits; rail service metrics.
fields.typical_moats: Rail network/rights-of-way; terminal density; brokerage network; dedicated contracts.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Truck capacity adjusts quickly through exits; rail infrastructure is effectively impossible to replicate.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; rail normalized OR and capex.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Equipment leases, fuel surcharges, pension, owner-operator classification.
fields.common_failure_modes: Freight recession, labor, regulation, service failure, capacity additions.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rail/network or niche fleet with density and pricing power.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Truck capacity exits → rates turn; rail service improvement unlocks price/volume.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is the marginal carrier's cash breakeven and exit rate?

fields.economic_engine: Passenger/cargo throughput × regulated/concession fees − operating/capex; often toll-road-like.
fields.core_kpis: Traffic; passengers; TEUs; aeronautical/non-aero revenue; tariff increases; capex; concession life.
fields.leading_indicators: Travel volumes; trade; port congestion; government concessions; route additions.
fields.typical_moats: Scarce concession, location, network, regulatory barriers.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Very long-lived, difficult-to-replicate assets; expansions slow and regulated.
fields.valuation_lenses: DCF, EV/EBITDA, concession NAV, dividend yield.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Concession liabilities, capitalized interest, regulatory assets, maintenance capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Traffic shock, political tariff controls, concession renewal, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Long concession with inflation-linked pricing and growing throughput.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Traffic recovery; tariff reset; capacity expansion commissioned.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much pricing is contractual versus politically discretionary?

fields.economic_engine: Vehicle production × content per vehicle × price − materials/labor; EV/ADAS can radically shift content.
fields.core_kpis: Global light vehicle production; content/vehicle; backlog; customer mix; margin; launches; warranty.
fields.leading_indicators: OEM production schedules; vehicle inventories; EV penetration; platform awards; semiconductor supply.
fields.typical_moats: Qualification, platform lock-in, safety certification, engineering integration; OEM bargaining limits returns.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Plant/tooling additions tied to programs; multi-year awards but rapid technology shifts.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; normalize cycle and launch costs.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Tooling reimbursements, warranty, restructuring, pension, program capitalized costs.
fields.common_failure_modes: OEM price-downs, platform loss, EV transition, recall, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: High-content niche supplier with IP, aftermarket or safety-critical products and diversified platforms.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Production recovery + new content launch + fixed-cost absorption.
fields.highest_evi_question: Does content growth outweigh annual OEM price-downs and EV substitution risk?

fields.economic_engine: Vehicle units × ASP − materials/labor/warranty + financing/software; enormous fixed capital and product-cycle risk.
fields.core_kpis: Deliveries; ASP; incentives; inventory days; utilization; gross margin; FCF; warranty; finance penetration.
fields.leading_indicators: Dealer inventory; incentives; order books; battery/raw materials; rates; used-car prices.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, scale, dealer/service network, software ecosystem, manufacturing efficiency.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity additions are large and slow; price wars can destroy returns rapidly.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF, sum-of-parts, enterprise value per unit/capacity.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Lease residuals, warranty, captive finance credit, regulatory credits, capitalized development.
fields.common_failure_modes: Price wars, overcapacity, recalls, tech transition, financing losses.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rare: brand-led premium economics or capital-light ecosystem/service layer.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory tightens, incentives fall; plant utilization rises; model launch resets mix.
fields.highest_evi_question: What normalized ROIC survives a full auto cycle?

fields.economic_engine: Units × price/mix − materials/channel costs; homebuilding is land turns × gross margin.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; backlog; housing starts; cancellation; ASP; gross margin; inventory; land position.
fields.leading_indicators: Mortgage rates; permits; builder sentiment; channel inventories; raw materials.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, distribution, design, land sourcing, local scale; varies widely.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Homebuilding land cycle is long; appliances/furniture capacity responds faster.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/B for builders, FCF; builders on normalized ROE/tangible book.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Land impairments, incentives, inventory capitalization, warranty, channel stuffing.
fields.common_failure_modes: Housing downturn, inventory write-downs, promotional pressure, fashion obsolescence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset-light branded niche or disciplined homebuilder with superior land turns.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Rates fall/order growth turns; channel destocking; gross margin recovers.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is inventory owned by the company, dealer, or customer—and where is the real excess?

fields.economic_engine: Unit demand × ASP − manufacturing/marketing; enthusiast installed bases can drive accessories/consumables.
fields.core_kpis: Sell-through; dealer inventory; ASP; participation rates; backlog; gross margin; new products.
fields.leading_indicators: Retail sell-through; channel inventory; consumer confidence; participation trends.
fields.typical_moats: Brand/community, IP, dealer network, installed base, ecosystem.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity generally flexible; fads and product cycles can be short.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; normalize pandemic-like demand spikes.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Dealer inventory, returns, capitalized development, promotional allowances.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fad reversal, dealer destocking, discretionary downturn, product failure.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche enthusiast brand with repeat accessories/consumables and community moat.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Channel inventory bottoms; new product cycle; participation reaccelerates.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is true end-consumer sell-through versus shipments into channel?

fields.economic_engine: Units × ASP × gross margin − marketing/retail costs; luxury depends on brand scarcity and price integrity.
fields.core_kpis: Comparable sales; DTC mix; gross margin; inventory; full-price sell-through; store productivity.
fields.leading_indicators: Search/social trends; tourism; wholesale inventories; China demand; discounting.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, heritage, scarcity, design, distribution control; low for commoditized apparel.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Supply is easy for basic apparel, but authentic luxury brand equity takes decades.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; brand/IP DCF; watch inventory-adjusted margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Inventory reserves, wholesale returns, lease liabilities, marketing capitalization narratives.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fashion miss, discounting, brand dilution, inventory build, China slowdown.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Luxury/niche brand with pricing power, controlled distribution and low dilution.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory cleared + gross margin normalization; new creative/product cycle.
fields.highest_evi_question: Can price rise faster than inflation without increased discounting?

fields.economic_engine: Traffic/occupancy × price − labor/food/property costs; franchised models separate brand economics from asset ownership.
fields.core_kpis: Same-store sales; traffic; ADR/RevPAR; occupancy; unit growth; store margin; franchise mix.
fields.leading_indicators: Reservations; credit-card spend; air travel; restaurant traffic; wage/food inflation.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, loyalty, franchise network, site density, unit economics, regulatory scarcity in gaming.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Restaurants can add units in months/years; hotels/casinos/cruise capacity slower and capital intensive.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; EV/room or unit economics where relevant.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Franchise vs company-owned mix, pre-opening costs, loyalty liabilities, lease accounting.
fields.common_failure_modes: Traffic decline, wage inflation, oversaturation, weak new-unit returns, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset-light franchise/royalty model with high unit ROIC and long runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Traffic turns + price holds; food/wage cost eases; new-unit cohorts mature.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are new units earning returns equal to or above mature cohorts after full occupancy/labor?

fields.economic_engine: Enrollment/membership/transaction volume × fee − service delivery and customer acquisition.
fields.core_kpis: Enrollments; retention; utilization; revenue/student/member; CAC; regulatory metrics.
fields.leading_indicators: Employment trends; education demand; household formation; regulatory approvals.
fields.typical_moats: Accreditation, brand, local network, trust, switching friction.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity often scalable; regulation/accreditation can slow entrants.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; cohort/unit economics.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Deferred revenue, student financing, regulatory reserves, acquisition costs.
fields.common_failure_modes: Regulatory action, poor outcomes, CAC inflation, churn.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Mission-critical service with recurring membership and reputation moat.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Enrollment/member growth turns; regulatory overhang clears; utilization rises.
fields.highest_evi_question: What objective customer outcome justifies retention and pricing?

fields.economic_engine: Wholesale volume × gross spread − logistics/working capital.
fields.core_kpis: Sales growth; gross margin; inventory turns; receivables; supplier concentration; ROIC.
fields.leading_indicators: Retailer orders; channel inventories; freight; supplier lead times.
fields.typical_moats: Scale procurement, exclusive distribution rights, logistics density.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Easy physical entry but relationships/exclusivity can be durable.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; working-capital normalized.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Inventory, rebates, returns, supplier incentives.
fields.common_failure_modes: Supplier bypass, retailer destocking, inventory obsolescence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Exclusive/niche distributor with high turns and fragmented end market.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Destocking ends; supplier shortage improves spreads.
fields.highest_evi_question: Who controls the customer—the distributor or supplier?

fields.economic_engine: Traffic × conversion × basket × gross margin − fulfillment/store/marketing cost.
fields.core_kpis: Comp sales; units; ticket; traffic; inventory; fulfillment cost; membership/ad revenue; ROIC.
fields.leading_indicators: Consumer spending; web traffic; search trends; inventory; promotional intensity.
fields.typical_moats: Scale, logistics, membership, ecosystem, data, private label.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Warehouses/logistics take years; digital competition can change rapidly.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, GMV-based unit economics where relevant.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Third-party gross vs net revenue, inventory, lease liabilities, fulfillment capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Margin-dilutive growth, promotions, inventory errors, disintermediation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Membership/marketplace flywheel with high repeat frequency and improving ancillary monetization.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory normalizes; mix/ads/membership raise margin; competitor exits.
fields.highest_evi_question: What part of gross profit comes from high-margin ancillary revenue versus merchandise?

fields.economic_engine: Store/online traffic × conversion × ticket × gross margin − occupancy/labor/fulfillment.
fields.core_kpis: Comp sales; traffic; ticket; gross margin; inventory; store productivity; new-store payback.
fields.leading_indicators: Credit-card spend; channel checks; housing/auto category trends; search traffic.
fields.typical_moats: Category authority, service expertise, distribution, private label, local scale.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Stores can be added quickly; category expertise/brand takes longer.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; unit economics and lease-adjusted returns.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Inventory reserves, leases, vendor allowances, loyalty liabilities.
fields.common_failure_modes: Category slowdown, inventory markdowns, e-commerce pressure, overexpansion.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche category leader with high turns, private label and strong new-store ROIC.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory clears; comp turns positive; gross margin normalizes.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are comp gains traffic-led or price-led, and what happens when inflation reverses?

fields.economic_engine: High-frequency volume × thin gross margin − logistics/labor; scale and turns dominate.
fields.core_kpis: Same-store sales; traffic; units; gross margin; inventory turns; shrink; private label; working capital.
fields.leading_indicators: Food inflation; SNAP/consumer budgets; supplier pricing; shrink trends.
fields.typical_moats: Scale procurement, location density, distribution centers, loyalty data.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Physical networks take years; margins remain structurally thin.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC; inventory-turn adjusted.
fields.accounting_data_traps: LIFO, supplier allowances, shrink reserves, leases.
fields.common_failure_modes: Price competition, wage inflation, shrink, weak pharmacy economics.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: High-turn retailer with private label, density and membership economics.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inflation moderates while unit volumes recover; shrink falls.
fields.highest_evi_question: Can gross margin expand without sacrificing traffic?

fields.economic_engine: Volume × price/mix − concentrate/commodity/packaging/distribution costs; brand economics can be exceptional.
fields.core_kpis: Organic volume; price/mix; gross margin; concentrate mix; distributor inventory; market share.
fields.leading_indicators: Retail scanner data; commodity inputs; channel inventories; emerging-market FX.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, distribution, shelf space, route-to-market, habitual consumption.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Production easy relative to building brand/distribution; brand moat can last decades.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Bottler consolidation, FX, commodity hedges, marketing spend.
fields.common_failure_modes: Volume elasticity, health/regulation, brand erosion, distributor conflict.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Global/niche brand with pricing power, high repeat purchase and low incremental capital.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Input costs fall while pricing holds; distribution expansion.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is price/mix being retained after commodity inflation recedes?

fields.economic_engine: Volume × price/mix − agricultural inputs/manufacturing/promotion; brands vary from commodity to durable.
fields.core_kpis: Volume; price/mix; gross margin; commodity basket; promotional spend; market share.
fields.leading_indicators: Scanner data; crop/livestock prices; retailer inventories; private-label share.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, formulation, distribution, sourcing scale; weak for commodity processors.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Commodity processing cyclical; branded capacity easy but brand building slow.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Commodity hedges, biological/ag inputs, restructuring, trade spend.
fields.common_failure_modes: Private-label pressure, commodity spikes, volume erosion, brand overextension.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche branded food with loyal repeat purchase and distribution runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Price-cost spread widens; volume recovers after inflation shock.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is volume loss temporary elasticity or structural share loss?

fields.economic_engine: Nicotine users × price/mix − manufacturing/marketing/tax; combustible decline offset by pricing and next-gen products.
fields.core_kpis: Volumes; price/mix; market share; reduced-risk product users; excise tax; FCF; buybacks.
fields.leading_indicators: Regulation; illicit trade; new-product approvals; cigarette volumes.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, addiction/habit, distribution, regulatory barriers.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: New entrants constrained by regulation; category volume structurally declining.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, FCF yield, dividend yield, DCF with declining volumes.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Litigation reserves, excise taxes, pension, regulatory provisions.
fields.common_failure_modes: Regulation, litigation, accelerated volume decline, failed next-gen transition.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Cash-generative franchise that transitions users to durable reduced-risk platform.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: New product approval/adoption; price exceeds volume decline.
fields.highest_evi_question: What terminal decline rate and regulatory outcome does valuation require?

fields.economic_engine: Recurring unit consumption × price/mix − commodities/marketing; mature but resilient.
fields.core_kpis: Organic sales; volume; price/mix; gross margin; market share; ad spend.
fields.leading_indicators: Scanner data; pulp/resin/chemical inputs; retailer inventories.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, shelf space, habit, scale purchasing.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity easy; brand/distribution hard.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, ROIC.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Restructuring, trade spend, commodity hedges, FX.
fields.common_failure_modes: Private label, brand erosion, persistent volume loss.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Category leader with habitual use, pricing power and emerging-market runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Commodity deflation while pricing sticks; innovation lifts mix.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is marketing spend maintaining share or masking weak organic demand?

fields.economic_engine: Repeat consumption × premium price − formulation/marketing/distribution; innovation and brand matter.
fields.core_kpis: Organic growth; volume; price/mix; DTC/retail mix; gross margin; CAC; repeat rates.
fields.leading_indicators: Retail sell-through; social/search trends; channel expansion; beauty category growth.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, formulation, community, shelf access, dermatologist/professional endorsement.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Manufacturing easy; durable brand/community difficult.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; cohort economics for DTC-heavy names.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Channel inventory, returns, marketing capitalization narratives, acquisition intangibles.
fields.common_failure_modes: Trend reversal, CAC inflation, retailer concentration, brand fad.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche brand with high repeat purchase, low CAC and large distribution white space.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Retail rollout + repeat rates hold; gross margin scales.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much growth comes from repeat customers versus paid acquisition?

fields.economic_engine: Procedures/installed base × device/consumable content − manufacturing/R&D/sales; recurring consumables can dominate economics.
fields.core_kpis: Procedure volumes; installed base; placements; utilization; consumable pull-through; ASP; gross margin; R&D.
fields.leading_indicators: Procedure data; hospital capex; reimbursement; FDA approvals; competitor recalls.
fields.typical_moats: Clinical evidence, regulatory approval, surgeon workflow, installed base, patents, switching/retraining cost.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Qualification/regulatory cycles slow entry; capacity often less constraining than adoption.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, DCF; installed-base plus consumables model.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Capitalized R&D/acquired IPR&D, stock comp, contingent consideration, warranty.
fields.common_failure_modes: Clinical failure, reimbursement cut, recall, new technology, hospital budget pressure.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Razor/razorblade medtech with growing installed base and high-margin recurring consumables.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Procedure recovery; new indication; reimbursement win; installed-base utilization inflects.
fields.highest_evi_question: What recurring revenue is generated per installed system over its lifetime?

fields.economic_engine: Patient/member volume × reimbursement − labor/medical cost; payors depend on premiums minus claims.
fields.core_kpis: Admissions; procedures; occupancy; reimbursement; labor cost; MLR; membership; payer mix; same-store revenue.
fields.leading_indicators: Utilization; wage rates; CMS rates; enrollment; flu/seasonality; policy changes.
fields.typical_moats: Local scale, physician networks, payer contracts, provider density, data.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Local capacity and regulation can constrain entry; labor remains variable bottleneck.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, P/E, FCF; payors on P/E/tangible capital; facilities on leverage-adjusted FCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Risk adjustment, medical reserves, provider receivables, leases, supplemental payments.
fields.common_failure_modes: Reimbursement cuts, utilization spikes, labor inflation, regulatory change, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialized provider with local density, repeat referrals, low capex and favorable reimbursement.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Labor normalizes; reimbursement catches cost inflation; utilization mix improves.
fields.highest_evi_question: Who bears medical-cost inflation and how quickly can reimbursement reset?

fields.economic_engine: Subscription/transaction revenue from provider/payor workflows − R&D/sales; value tied to embedded workflows and data.
fields.core_kpis: ARR; retention; bookings; implementation backlog; gross margin; sales efficiency; client count.
fields.leading_indicators: Hospital IT budgets; regulatory mandates; contract wins; provider consolidation.
fields.typical_moats: Workflow integration, proprietary data, switching costs, regulatory complexity.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Software supply easy, but replacing clinical/admin workflows is slow and risky.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/ARR, EV/FCF, P/E for mature; Rule-of-40 style unit economics with caution.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Capitalized implementation/software, stock comp, contract assets, acquisition intangibles.
fields.common_failure_modes: Long implementations, customer concentration, interoperability disruption, AI commoditization.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Vertical workflow platform with high GRR and expansion into adjacent modules.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Bookings acceleration; implementation bottleneck clears; margin expands.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is gross retention after excluding acquisitions and cross-sell?

fields.economic_engine: Probability-adjusted future drug cash flows; value changes discontinuously with clinical/regulatory evidence.
fields.core_kpis: Trial endpoints; enrollment; safety; cash runway; burn; probability of success; addressable patients; pricing.
fields.leading_indicators: Clinical readouts; FDA/EMA meetings; competitor data; enrollment updates; financing.
fields.typical_moats: Patents, biological insight, clinical differentiation, manufacturing know-how.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Entry can be fast scientifically but development takes years; capital markets matter.
fields.valuation_lenses: rNPV, probability-adjusted DCF, EV/cash for preclinical context—not conventional P/E.
fields.accounting_data_traps: R&D capitalization narratives, milestone accounting, stock-based comp, warrant dilution.
fields.common_failure_modes: Trial failure, safety, financing dilution, competitor superiority, patent weakness.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Platform with repeated validated biology and self-funded pipeline is rare but valuable.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Binary/milestone catalyst where market misestimates probability or commercial magnitude.
fields.highest_evi_question: What exact evidence changes probability of technical and regulatory success?

fields.economic_engine: Drug volume × net price over patent life − COGS/R&D/SG&A; portfolio must replace patent expirations.
fields.core_kpis: Prescription volume; new-to-brand; net price; gross-to-net; patent dates; pipeline NPV; R&D productivity.
fields.leading_indicators: Prescription data; formulary coverage; trial readouts; FDA decisions; generic/biosimilar entries.
fields.typical_moats: Patents, clinical differentiation, physician trust, manufacturing, commercial scale.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Patents create temporary monopolies; competitive response accelerates after success.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, DCF by product, SOTP/rNPV.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Gross-to-net accruals, acquired IPR&D, milestone payments, restructuring.
fields.common_failure_modes: Patent cliffs, safety, pricing regulation, pipeline failure.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialty pharma with durable orphan/niche franchises and disciplined pipeline acquisition.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Launch inflection, label expansion, competitor setback, patent litigation resolution.
fields.highest_evi_question: What proportion of enterprise value depends on assets within five years of loss of exclusivity?

fields.economic_engine: Instrument placements + consumables/services tied to research/bioprocess activity; installed-base model can be excellent.
fields.core_kpis: Instrument orders; consumables pull-through; bioprocess demand; book-to-bill; China exposure; R&D funding.
fields.leading_indicators: Biotech funding; NIH budgets; bioprocess utilization; pharma R&D; China stimulus/regulation.
fields.typical_moats: Installed base, proprietary consumables, workflow validation, regulatory quality systems.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Instrument competitors can emerge, but consumable workflows and validation create switching costs.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, installed-base DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Channel inventory, COVID normalization, acquired intangibles, restructuring.
fields.common_failure_modes: Biotech funding downturn, destocking, China weakness, technology obsolescence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Instrument/consumable platform with high recurring pull-through and expanding applications.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Destocking ends; bioprocess utilization rebounds; new instrument cycle.
fields.highest_evi_question: What consumables revenue is generated per installed instrument and how stable is it through funding cycles?

fields.economic_engine: Earning assets × NIM + fees − credit losses − opex; deposit franchise and underwriting determine long-run ROE.
fields.core_kpis: Deposit growth/mix/cost; NIM; loan growth; NCOs; criticized assets; CET1; tangible book; efficiency ratio.
fields.leading_indicators: Yield curve; deposit betas; delinquencies; CRE values; loan officer surveys; funding competition.
fields.typical_moats: Low-cost core deposits, local relationships, underwriting culture, scale in niche verticals.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Balance-sheet growth constrained by capital/liquidity; credit cycles can take years to surface.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/TBV, P/E, ROTCE, dividend discount.
fields.accounting_data_traps: CECL reserves, AOCI, held-to-maturity marks, nonaccruals, deposit classification.
fields.common_failure_modes: Credit losses, deposit flight, duration mismatch, CRE concentration, weak capital.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche bank with durable low-cost deposits, conservative underwriting and fee income.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Deposit costs peak + asset yields reprice; credit fears prove overdone.
fields.highest_evi_question: What losses are embedded in tangible book after marking securities and loans economically?

fields.economic_engine: Varies: diversified finance, payments, specialty lending, holding companies; core is spread/fees × volume minus losses/capital.
fields.core_kpis: Transaction volume; take rate; funding cost; credit losses; assets under management where relevant; capital returns.
fields.leading_indicators: Consumer spend; rates; funding markets; merchant volumes; regulatory changes.
fields.typical_moats: Networks, licenses, data, low-cost funding, distribution, scale.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Network businesses compound slowly; lenders' capacity follows funding and credit cycles.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, P/TBV, EV/EBITDA for fee businesses, DCF/SOTP.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Securitization, gain-on-sale, fair value, CECL, regulatory capital.
fields.common_failure_modes: Funding shock, regulation, credit loss, take-rate compression.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Payment/network or specialty finance niche with data advantage and low losses.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Funding costs fall; transaction mix improves; credit cycle stabilizes.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is growth consuming capital or generating self-funded network economics?

fields.economic_engine: Receivables × net interest spread − credit losses − servicing/marketing; underwriting and funding are everything.
fields.core_kpis: Loan/receivable growth; yield; funding cost; delinquencies; charge-offs; reserves; CAC; payment rate.
fields.leading_indicators: Consumer delinquencies; unemployment; card spend; securitization spreads; used-car/home values.
fields.typical_moats: Proprietary underwriting data, low-cost deposits/funding, distribution partnerships.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Credit capacity expands in booms and contracts after losses; competition is cyclical.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, P/TBV, ROE, excess capital DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: CECL, gain-on-sale, securitization residuals, deferred acquisition costs.
fields.common_failure_modes: Under-reserving, funding freeze, adverse selection, regulation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche lender with superior underwriting and low-cost captive distribution.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Losses peak below expectations; funding spreads compress; reserve releases.
fields.highest_evi_question: How would losses behave under vintage-level stress, not just portfolio averages?

fields.economic_engine: AUM/trading/issuance/data volume × fee rates − compensation; exchanges/data can be recurring, brokers more cyclical.
fields.core_kpis: AUM; net flows; fee rate; trading volume; underwriting pipeline; client assets; comp ratio; data subscriptions.
fields.leading_indicators: Markets; volatility; IPO/M&A calendar; fund flows; futures/open interest.
fields.typical_moats: Brand, distribution, exchange liquidity/network effects, proprietary indices/data, switching costs.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: People-based capacity can scale quickly; exchange/data moats compound over decades.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; exchanges on recurring data/volume mix; asset managers on AUM/fees.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Performance fees, seed investments, compensation accruals, fair-value marks.
fields.common_failure_modes: Fee compression, poor performance, market drawdown, regulatory shifts.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Exchange/data platform or specialist asset manager with durable flows and high incremental margins.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Capital-markets cycle reopens; volatility/trading spikes; net flows turn.
fields.highest_evi_question: What revenue persists if asset prices and transaction activity are flat for three years?

fields.economic_engine: Levered mortgage assets × spread − hedging/funding losses; book value and funding determine survival.
fields.core_kpis: Book value; leverage; asset yield; repo cost; duration gap; CPR; hedges; dividend coverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Yield curve; mortgage spreads; volatility; repo conditions; prepayments.
fields.typical_moats: Scale/funding relationships; generally limited moat.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capital availability drives asset growth; leverage makes cycles violent.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/B, dividend yield, ROE on book.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Fair-value marks, hedge accounting, non-GAAP distributable earnings.
fields.common_failure_modes: Margin calls, spread widening, prepayment shocks, dilution.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rare; disciplined manager buying assets below replacement/book during dislocation.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Mortgage spreads tighten from panic; funding stabilizes.
fields.highest_evi_question: What happens to book value under parallel and curve-shape shocks?

fields.economic_engine: Premium − claims − expenses + investment income; value compounds through underwriting profit and float.
fields.core_kpis: Combined ratio; loss ratio; expense ratio; rate change; retention; reserve development; book value/share; ROE.
fields.leading_indicators: Commercial pricing surveys; catastrophe losses; repair/medical inflation; bond yields; reinsurance renewals.
fields.typical_moats: Distribution, underwriting data, specialty expertise, customer relationships, scale, regulatory licenses.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capital enters after hard markets; specialty expertise/distribution can keep returns durable.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/B, P/E, ROE, tangible book growth; sum underwriting + investment income.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Reserve releases, catastrophe normalization, unrealized investment marks, reinsurance recoverables.
fields.common_failure_modes: Under-reserving, social inflation, catastrophe aggregation, pricing softness, investment losses.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Specialty insurer/broker with disciplined underwriting, recurring distribution and high book-value compounding.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Rate > loss-cost inflation; reserve fears peak; investment yield reprices upward.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are favorable reserve developments genuine conservatism or masking current-year weakness?

fields.economic_engine: Billable labor/managed services/cloud infrastructure × rate − personnel/infrastructure; recurring managed services can improve quality.
fields.core_kpis: Bookings; backlog; utilization; bill rates; attrition; recurring mix; cloud workload; FCF.
fields.leading_indicators: Enterprise IT budgets; cloud migrations; outsourcing deals; wage trends.
fields.typical_moats: Customer integration, certifications, scale, vertical expertise, proprietary platforms.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Labor scales quickly; deeply embedded managed services are sticky.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; organic growth and margin quality.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Capitalized software, restructuring, stock comp, pass-through cloud revenue.
fields.common_failure_modes: AI automation, pricing pressure, client budget cuts, wage inflation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Vertical managed-services platform with high retention and automation-driven margin upside.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Utilization recovers; large deal ramps; AI lowers delivery cost faster than price.
fields.highest_evi_question: Will AI commoditize billable hours or expand margins through automation?

fields.economic_engine: ARR/subscription × retention/expansion − R&D/S&M; high gross margins make CAC and durability decisive.
fields.core_kpis: ARR; GRR/NRR; bookings; RPO; CAC payback; gross margin; FCF margin; SBC/dilution.
fields.leading_indicators: CIO budgets; seat growth; usage; renewal cohorts; channel checks; cloud consumption.
fields.typical_moats: Workflow lock-in, data network effects, ecosystem, developer adoption, brand, switching cost.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Software supply easy; distribution, data and embedded workflows take years; AI may reset barriers.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/ARR, EV/FCF, P/E for mature, DCF; growth + FCF quality.
fields.accounting_data_traps: SBC, capitalized commissions/R&D, billings vs revenue, acquisition adjustments.
fields.common_failure_modes: AI disruption, seat contraction, poor retention, CAC inflation, dilution.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Vertical mission-critical software with high GRR, expansion, low CAC and long runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Bookings/RPO trough; sales productivity turns; AI feature monetization; margin inflects.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is retention by cohort and how much growth depends on seat inflation versus true value expansion?

fields.economic_engine: Networking units/ports × ASP + software/service − silicon/components/manufacturing; product cycles and customer capex dominate.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; backlog; revenue by speed/gen; deferred revenue; gross margin; service mix; customer concentration.
fields.leading_indicators: Cloud/telco capex; bandwidth growth; optical/network standards; lead times.
fields.typical_moats: Protocol/IP, installed base, interoperability, switching costs, channel ecosystem.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Hardware supply can ramp in 1–2 years; qualification and standards slow switching.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, SOTP recurring software/service.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Deferred revenue, channel inventory, component purchase commitments, acquisitions.
fields.common_failure_modes: Standards transition, hyperscaler insourcing, component glut, customer concentration.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Installed-base vendor with recurring software/service and increasing content per network.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: New bandwidth generation ramps (800G/1.6T), qualification wins, component shortage eases.
fields.highest_evi_question: Does higher bandwidth create more supplier gross profit per rack, or just lower $/bit?

fields.economic_engine: Device/storage units × ASP − components/manufacturing; ecosystem services can alter quality.
fields.core_kpis: Units; ASP; channel inventory; installed base; attach/service revenue; component cost; gross margin.
fields.leading_indicators: PC/server/storage shipments; DRAM/NAND prices; channel inventory; refresh cycles.
fields.typical_moats: Brand/ecosystem, OS integration, enterprise qualification, scale procurement.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Capacity often flexible via ODMs; ecosystem/installed base more durable.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; SOTP services.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Channel inventory, warranty, supplier commitments, capitalized software.
fields.common_failure_modes: Commoditization, component inflation, refresh-cycle stall, cloud substitution.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Hardware ecosystem with high-margin services/consumables and loyal installed base.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Refresh cycle + inventory normalization; component costs fall before ASP.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much margin is structural ecosystem value versus temporary component pricing?

fields.economic_engine: Units/content × ASP − components/manufacturing; includes instrumentation, components, EMS and distributors.
fields.core_kpis: Orders; book-to-bill; backlog; design wins; content/unit; utilization; inventory; gross margin.
fields.leading_indicators: PMI; semiconductor/electronics inventories; design wins; customer capex.
fields.typical_moats: Qualification, precision know-how, design-in, test data, switching cost; EMS/distribution moats differ.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Component capacity can be cyclical; high-spec instrumentation qualification slow.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF; design-win pipeline and normalized margins.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Distributor gross vs net, inventory reserves, customer-owned tooling, acquisition intangibles.
fields.common_failure_modes: Design loss, inventory correction, customer insourcing, component commoditization.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Precision sensor/instrument/component with long design cycles, high content growth and aftermarket.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory correction ends; design wins enter production; utilization lifts margins.
fields.highest_evi_question: How long from design win to revenue, and how sticky is the socket across product generations?

fields.economic_engine: Wafer/device units × ASP + equipment intensity − fab/equipment cost; utilization and technology transitions create nonlinear cycles.
fields.core_kpis: Wafer starts; utilization; bit growth; ASP; inventories; capex; bookings; WFE; advanced packaging/HBM content.
fields.leading_indicators: Memory spot/contract prices; foundry utilization; hyperscaler capex; equipment lead times; node transitions.
fields.typical_moats: Process IP, scale, ecosystem, qualification, installed base/service, manufacturing learning curves.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Fabs/equipment capacity takes years and billions; shortages/gluts can persist then reverse violently.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, replacement cost; normalized mid-cycle plus secular content model.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Inventory, capital intensity, depreciation, stock comp, customer prepayments, export controls.
fields.common_failure_modes: Overcapacity, node execution, customer concentration, export restrictions, rapid substitution.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Fabless/IP/equipment/inspection platform with rising content per compute and durable installed base.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Inventory/utilization bottom → pricing/orders turn → massive earnings elasticity; new node/HBM packaging bottleneck.
fields.highest_evi_question: Which bottleneck is next, and what supply response date ends the scarcity rent?

fields.economic_engine: Subscribers/lines × ARPU − network opex/capex; fixed broadband economics improve with density.
fields.core_kpis: Net adds; churn; ARPU; broadband penetration; capex; FCF; fiber passings; leverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Subscriber trends; fiber builds; pricing/promotions; spectrum/regulation.
fields.typical_moats: Local network, spectrum, rights-of-way, bundled services; high fixed costs.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Networks take years and huge capital; overbuild can permanently impair returns.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, sum-of-parts, subscriber/household metrics.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Leases, spectrum capitalization, pension, restructuring, handset financing.
fields.common_failure_modes: Price wars, overbuild, capex creep, leverage, regulation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Local broadband/fiber network with high penetration, low churn and declining capex intensity.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Capex peaks; fiber penetration ramps; pricing stabilizes; FCF inflects.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is mature maintenance capex after the current build cycle ends?

fields.economic_engine: Subscribers × ARPU − network/spectrum/device subsidies; scale and spectrum portfolio matter.
fields.core_kpis: Net adds; churn; ARPU; service revenue; spectrum; capex; FCF; device promotions.
fields.leading_indicators: Porting data; promotions; spectrum auctions; network quality; subscriber growth.
fields.typical_moats: Spectrum licenses, network density, scale, distribution.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Network/spectrum capacity costly and slow; pricing can still be competitive.
fields.valuation_lenses: EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, subscriber value.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Spectrum amortization, leases, handset receivables, tower contracts.
fields.common_failure_modes: Promotional wars, spectrum costs, capex, saturation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Low-churn operator with network quality and structurally lower capex.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Promotions ease; capex falls; ARPU rises.
fields.highest_evi_question: Is ARPU growth from real pricing or device/accounting mix?

fields.economic_engine: Audience/reach × ad/subscription monetization − content/distribution; legacy broadcast/cable differs from digital advertising.
fields.core_kpis: Ad revenue; impressions; CPM; subscribers; churn; affiliate fees; content cost.
fields.leading_indicators: Ad spend; ratings; upfronts; cord-cutting; political ad cycles.
fields.typical_moats: Owned audience, local licenses, brand/content rights; legacy distribution eroding.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Digital ad inventory abundant; scarce premium audiences/content remain valuable.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, SOTP; subscriber LTV where relevant.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Content amortization, retransmission, political ad normalization, goodwill.
fields.common_failure_modes: Audience fragmentation, cord cutting, ad recession, platform dependence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Niche information/media asset with loyal paid audience and proprietary content/data.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Ad cycle turns; rights renewal; cost reset; streaming breakeven.
fields.highest_evi_question: Does the company own the customer relationship or rent distribution from a platform?

fields.economic_engine: Content/IP engagement × monetization across box office, subscriptions, licensing, games/merchandise − content cost.
fields.core_kpis: Bookings; subscribers; engagement; slate; franchise revenue; content spend; margins.
fields.leading_indicators: Release calendars; engagement rankings; box office; game preorders; subscriber trends.
fields.typical_moats: Franchise IP, creative talent, communities, distribution, network effects in games.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Hit-driven supply unpredictable; durable franchises can compound for decades.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF, franchise SOTP; game bookings-based models.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Content capitalization/amortization, deferred revenue, participations, impairment.
fields.common_failure_modes: Flops, franchise fatigue, cost inflation, platform dependence.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Durable IP with recurring game/service monetization and multiple distribution channels.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Major release exceeds expectations; live-service bookings inflect; cost rationalization.
fields.highest_evi_question: What percentage of value comes from repeatable franchises versus unrepeatable hits?

fields.economic_engine: Users × engagement × monetization (ads/subscriptions/commerce) − infrastructure/R&D; network effects can be enormous.
fields.core_kpis: DAU/MAU; time spent; ad impressions; CPM; conversion; take rate; CAC; capex; FCF.
fields.leading_indicators: Ad budgets; app usage; creator activity; privacy/regulation; product launches.
fields.typical_moats: Social/network effects, data, identity, creator ecosystems, distribution.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Digital supply scales instantly, but networks can tip toward winners.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/FCF, DCF; user economics and ad load.
fields.accounting_data_traps: SBC, traffic acquisition costs, capex, gross vs net ad/commerce revenue.
fields.common_failure_modes: Platform shift, regulation, privacy, AI disruption, user migration.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Network with rising monetization per user and low incremental capital.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Ad pricing/engagement turns; new product monetizes; cost discipline.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are engagement gains durable among younger cohorts and creators?

fields.economic_engine: Rate base × allowed ROE + unregulated generation − financing/opex; load growth can accelerate capital deployment.
fields.core_kpis: Rate-base growth; allowed ROE; load growth; capex; regulatory lag; FFO/debt; customer mix.
fields.leading_indicators: Rate cases; data-center load requests; interconnection; generation retirements; bond yields.
fields.typical_moats: Exclusive service territory, regulated asset base, transmission rights.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Generation/transmission takes years; regulatory approval and financing constrain supply.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, P/B, dividend yield, DCF on rate base.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Regulatory assets/liabilities, storm costs, pension, nuclear decommissioning.
fields.common_failure_modes: Regulatory disallowance, wildfire/storm liability, financing dilution, project overruns.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Utility with above-average load/rate-base growth, constructive regulator and self-funded capex.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Large load contracts become funded; rate case improves ROE; financing costs fall.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much announced load is contracted and creditworthy versus speculative queue demand?

fields.economic_engine: Regulated rate base × allowed return; throughput/weather affects near-term volumes.
fields.core_kpis: Rate base; customer growth; capex; allowed ROE; weather-normalized volumes; FFO/debt.
fields.leading_indicators: Rate cases; housing starts; pipeline safety mandates; gas policy.
fields.typical_moats: Exclusive territory, network infrastructure.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Slow, regulated capital additions.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, P/B, dividend yield.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Regulatory assets, pension, environmental obligations.
fields.common_failure_modes: Decarbonization policy, regulatory lag, safety incidents.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Constructive-regulation utility with steady customer/rate-base growth.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Rate case reset; safety replacement program accelerates allowed investment.
fields.highest_evi_question: Will new capex earn full allowed return or face stranded-asset risk?

fields.economic_engine: Portfolio of regulated electric/gas/water rate bases; capital allocation and jurisdiction mix matter.
fields.core_kpis: Rate-base growth by jurisdiction; ROE; capex; FFO/debt; dividend.
fields.leading_indicators: Rate cases; load growth; bond yields; jurisdiction policy.
fields.typical_moats: Diversified regulated franchises, scale.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Slow capacity; portfolio complexity can hide quality differences.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, P/B, DCF/SOTP.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Regulatory assets, pension, segment allocations.
fields.common_failure_modes: Bad jurisdiction, financing, project overruns.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Portfolio tilted to constructive jurisdictions with above-average rate-base growth.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Asset sale/restructuring improves mix; load growth surprises.
fields.highest_evi_question: Which jurisdiction drives marginal capital and what is earned ROE versus allowed ROE?

fields.economic_engine: Customers/usage × regulated tariffs − treatment/distribution cost; acquisitions expand rate base.
fields.core_kpis: Customer growth; rate-base growth; allowed ROE; capex; leakage; acquisition pipeline.
fields.leading_indicators: Rate cases; drought; municipal privatization; infrastructure funding.
fields.typical_moats: Scarce local network, water rights, regulation, acquisition expertise.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Extremely slow to replicate; replacement needs are multi-decade.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/E, EV/EBITDA, dividend yield, rate-base DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Regulatory assets, acquisition premiums, infrastructure surcharge accounting.
fields.common_failure_modes: Political rate pressure, drought, contamination liability, rich valuation.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Fragmented local systems consolidated by disciplined operator with constructive regulators.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Acquisition approval, rate case, infrastructure surcharge.
fields.highest_evi_question: Can acquisition premiums be recovered in rates without diluting returns?

industries.name: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

fields.economic_engine: Generation MWh × power price/PPA − fuel/opex/capex; asset mix and contract duration define volatility.
fields.core_kpis: MW; capacity factor; realized power price; PPA tenor; merchant exposure; pipeline; capex; leverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Power forwards; capacity auctions; data-center PPAs; tax credits; interconnection queues.
fields.typical_moats: Scarce interconnects, low-cost generation, permits, long PPAs.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Projects take years; interconnection is often bottleneck; capital can flood attractive subsidies.
fields.valuation_lenses: DCF by asset/PPA, EV/MW, EV/EBITDA, CAFD yield.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Tax equity, project finance, derivative marks, development pipeline probabilities.
