fields.common_failure_modes: Merchant price collapse, curtailment, financing, policy change, construction overruns.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Contracted low-cost fleet with valuable interconnects and disciplined development.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Power scarcity/PPAs reprice; project reaches NTP; financing cost falls.
fields.highest_evi_question: What portion of pipeline has interconnection, offtake and financing—not just site control?

fields.economic_engine: Property NOI across multiple types − interest/corporate costs; capital allocation and portfolio mix dominate.
fields.core_kpis: Same-store NOI; occupancy; leasing spreads; AFFO; leverage; NAV discount; development yields.
fields.leading_indicators: Cap rates; credit spreads; leasing data; property transactions.
fields.typical_moats: Scale, access to capital, local operating expertise; diversification can dilute edge.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Property supply slow but varies by segment.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, implied cap rate, DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: AFFO adjustments, straight-line rent, recurring capex, JV accounting.
fields.common_failure_modes: Bad mix, leverage, value-destructive acquisitions.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Exceptional allocator buying/selling assets through cycles at NAV-accretive spreads.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: NAV discount closes after asset sales/deleveraging.
fields.highest_evi_question: Does diversification lower risk or hide inferior assets?

fields.economic_engine: Warehouse rent × occupancy − property costs; development spread and rent mark-to-market drive value.
fields.core_kpis: Occupancy; cash leasing spreads; same-store NOI; development pipeline; yield on cost; rent mark-to-market.
fields.leading_indicators: Warehouse supply; absorption; e-commerce; vacancy; construction starts.
fields.typical_moats: Location, land bank, development platform, tenant network.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Supply takes 1–3 years; land/entitlements constrain prime markets.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, implied cap rate, development NAV.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Straight-line rent, tenant improvements, recurring capex, JV development.
fields.common_failure_modes: Overbuilding, tenant concentration, cap-rate expansion.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Infill portfolio with embedded below-market rents and accretive development runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Supply starts collapse while demand holds; leases reset materially higher.
fields.highest_evi_question: What percentage of rents reset in the next 3 years and at what mark-to-market?

fields.economic_engine: Rooms × occupancy × ADR − hotel operating costs − fixed charges; very high operating leverage.
fields.core_kpis: RevPAR; occupancy; ADR; group bookings; EBITDA margin; renovation capex; leverage.
fields.leading_indicators: Travel bookings; convention calendars; airline capacity; corporate travel.
fields.typical_moats: Location, asset quality, brand/operator agreements; limited corporate moat.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: New hotels take years but demand can collapse instantly.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, EV/EBITDA, FFO/AFFO, value per key.
fields.accounting_data_traps: FF&E reserves, management fees, renovations, seasonality.
fields.common_failure_modes: Recession, new supply, labor, leverage.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Scarce luxury/convention assets bought below replacement cost.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Group/business travel recovery; renovation completion; supply constrained.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much EBITDA changes for 1% RevPAR movement after fixed costs?

fields.economic_engine: Leased square feet × rent − property costs/capex; tenant demand and obsolescence dominate.
fields.core_kpis: Occupancy; leasing spreads; expirations; TI/LC; same-store NOI; debt maturities.
fields.leading_indicators: Office utilization; sublease availability; job growth; new supply; transactions.
fields.typical_moats: Prime location, modern amenities, transit; many assets have weak moat post-remote work.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Supply slow, but demand impairment can make existing stock obsolete.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, implied cap rate, FFO adjusted for TI/LC.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Straight-line rent, concessions, tenant improvements, capex capitalization.
fields.common_failure_modes: Structural vacancy, refinancing, obsolete assets.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Rare trophy/infill portfolio with low basis and strong tenant demand.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Leasing trough; asset sales validate NAV; debt refinance removes solvency fear.
fields.highest_evi_question: What is economic occupancy after concessions and required tenant capex?

fields.economic_engine: Rent from senior housing/medical/life-science properties − property/financing; operator health matters.
fields.core_kpis: Occupancy; rent coverage; operator EBITDAR; same-store NOI; lease escalators; development.
fields.leading_indicators: Senior demographics; labor costs; reimbursement; life-science funding.
fields.typical_moats: Purpose-built assets, relationships, local scale, licensing.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Supply slow; operator economics can be fragile.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, implied cap rate.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Operator loans, straight-line rent, development, recurring capex.
fields.common_failure_modes: Tenant distress, reimbursement, labor, overbuilding.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Medical/senior housing platform with improving occupancy and strong operator coverage.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Occupancy recovery + labor normalization; troubled tenant reset.
fields.highest_evi_question: Can tenants cover rent after normalized labor and maintenance capex?

fields.economic_engine: Units × effective rent × occupancy − property costs; supply pipeline and household formation drive growth.
fields.core_kpis: Occupancy; blended rent growth; concessions; turnover; same-store NOI; development yield.
fields.leading_indicators: Apartment deliveries; permits; household formation; wages; mortgage affordability.
fields.typical_moats: Infill locations, operating scale, data; limited differentiation beyond location.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Supply takes 2–4 years, creating visible boom/bust pipeline.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, implied cap rate.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Concessions, capitalized renovations, same-store definitions.
fields.common_failure_modes: Supply wave, rent controls, property taxes, cap-rate expansion.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Low-cost operator with scarce infill assets and accretive redevelopment.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Supply deliveries peak; starts collapse; rent growth reaccelerates.
fields.highest_evi_question: When do new deliveries peak relative to lease renewal calendar?

fields.economic_engine: Tenant sales support rent × occupancy − property costs; quality malls/centers can benefit from scarce locations.
fields.core_kpis: Occupancy; leasing spreads; tenant sales/sqft; bad debt; redevelopment yield; same-store NOI.
fields.leading_indicators: Retail bankruptcies; store openings/closures; consumer spend; new supply.
fields.typical_moats: Location, tenant mix, zoning, experiential density.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: New prime retail supply limited in many markets.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, implied cap rate.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Straight-line rent, redevelopment capitalization, tenant allowances.
fields.common_failure_modes: Tenant failures, e-commerce, overleveraged assets.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Grocery/necessity or top-tier center with pricing power and redevelopment runway.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Bankruptcies fall; occupancy rises; redevelopment leased.
fields.highest_evi_question: Are tenant sales productivity and occupancy strong enough to support rent increases?

fields.economic_engine: Varies by towers, data centers, storage, timber, gaming/other: lease/usage revenue on specialized infrastructure.
fields.core_kpis: Tenant churn; same-store NOI; bookings; utilization; power availability; tower amendments; storage street rates.
fields.leading_indicators: Wireless capex; data-center demand; storage move-ins; timber prices; tenant capex.
fields.typical_moats: Specialized asset scarcity, network/location, permits, power/interconnect, switching cost.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Often very slow supply for towers/data centers/power; self-storage faster.
fields.valuation_lenses: P/NAV, P/AFFO, EV/EBITDA, asset-specific DCF.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Development capex, straight-line rent, power pass-through, customer concentration.
fields.common_failure_modes: Tenant concentration, technology substitution, overbuilding, financing.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset network with embedded escalators, high incremental margins and scarce locations/power.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Lease-up/utilization inflection; power scarcity reprices; tenant capex cycle turns.
fields.highest_evi_question: What physical constraint—power, zoning, fiber, location—prevents new supply?

fields.economic_engine: Development spread, management/brokerage fees, transaction volumes and owned-property cash flows.
fields.core_kpis: Pre-sales; backlog; land bank; development margin; AUM; fee revenue; transactions; net debt.
fields.leading_indicators: Cap rates; mortgage rates; transaction volumes; permits; property prices.
fields.typical_moats: Local land expertise, brand, capital relationships, management scale, data.
fields.capital_cycle_supply_response: Development supply lags but can overbuild; fee businesses scale faster.
fields.valuation_lenses: NAV/SOTP, P/E for fee businesses, P/B for developers.
fields.accounting_data_traps: Land valuation, capitalized interest, JV/off-balance-sheet debt, percentage-of-completion.
fields.common_failure_modes: Property downturn, leverage, land impairments, transaction freeze.
fields.ideal_compounder_setup: Asset-light manager/service platform with recurring AUM and low capital needs.
fields.ideal_inflection_setup: Transaction cycle reopens; distressed land bought cheaply; pre-sales turn.
fields.highest_evi_question: How much value is fee-based recurring earnings versus leveraged land/property exposure?
